$comment: The fixed query workload PRD 9.1 requires a reference profile to name. Its content hash goes
into every measurement, so changing a query here changes the profile and the numbers stop
being comparable to the previous run — which is the point.
It is drawn from the labelled datasets rather than invented separately: these are queries the
corpus can answer for the principal who asks, plus two that it cannot, because a latency
profile made only of hits misses the abstention path entirely.
Principals are the ones examples/corpus.groups.json declares. A workload that asked every
question as the same principal would exercise one permission predicate and one posting list.

queries.query: how long are support conversations kept
who handles an escalation with the freight vendor
checkout is failing, what do I check first
when should an incident be escalated and to whom
what makes a page justified rather than a ticket
how long is a request trace retained
when does the ledger cut off at quarter end
what happens to an accrual in the following quarter
what is the wifi password in the Leeds depot
what percentage of revenue is held in the refund reserve
